Show a standup report for today, or for the period that you choose. The report lists done entries, open blockers, open next items, and a Stale line.

## Usage

    gournal standup [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-y, --yesterday` | Report on yesterday and today. |  |
| `-w, --week` | Report on the current week. |  |
| `-m, --month` | Report on the current month. |  |
| `--from <date>` | Start of the period (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `--to <date>` | End of the period (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Show only entries of this project. |  |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Show only entries of this repository. |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Show only entries with all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |  |
| `--activity` | List every GitHub activity item that has no entry. Without this option, the report shows only counts. |  |

## Examples

Show today's standup. The report lists done entries by project, then open blockers and next items.

```console
$ gournal standup

Standup: Today (2026-11-15)

  Done
  billing-api
  16:04  Fix rounding error in invoice totals

  web-app
  16:04  Move the settings page to the new form components
  16:04  Add keyboard focus styles to the date picker

  Blockers
    Nov 15  0MC5VPCQ  Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging  [billing-api]

  Next
    Nov 15  V91XZBEK  Add a regression test for tax rounding  [billing-api]
```
